updateTo.notes: Apexline 1.1.14 for Apple silicon Macs. Track Map cars now move smoothly and sit on their real positions in live sessions and replays: no more jumping or random speed-ups, pit-lane cars shown in the pit lane, and correct placement from the race start. Also fixes a crash when starting a Track Map replay. Download the zip, unzip it and drag Apexline to Applications.
